reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, so I actually have a reason, and $24.99 for the first box with a money-back guarantee is easy to risk. The named lab and the report behind the QR code make it feel less sketchy than the random brands.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. After the launch price it feels like a lot for a month.
would_change_my_mind: If the launch price were gone and it was the full $29.99, I would probably skip it and grab a cheaper bottle.
